body.p: (Phase 1 planning; designed in packet ). Four new public headers, outside the substrate: xml.h (XML parser into any sxml_tree_builder), processor.h (the processor of , owning name pool, type registry and item heap, plus the host resolver interface for fn:doc and the implicit timezone and current dateTime), xpath.h (static context configuration, compile, evaluate) and serialize.h (adaptive method only in Phase 1; XML, JSON and text methods arrive with XQuery in Phase 3). The CLI and the QT4 driver use only these and the substrate headers. They are not frozen at the Phase 1 gate; they become stable with the first public release (Phase 2). The TypeScript package of also waits for Phase 2: Phase 1 runs the slice under Node.js WASI only.
